ProtectedCardData.name: Protected Card Data
ProtectedCardData.definition: Replacement of the message element PlainCardData by a digital envelope using a cryptographic key.

PrivateCardData.name: Private Card Data
PrivateCardData.definition: Replacement of the message element PlainCardData by a private envelope.

PlainCardData.name: Plain Card Data
PlainCardData.definition: Sensitive data associated with the card performing the transaction.

PaymentAccountReference.name: Payment Account Reference
PaymentAccountReference.definition: Unique reference to the card, used by both merchants and acquirers to link tokenized and non-tokenized transactions associated to the same underlying card.

MaskedPAN.name: Masked PAN
MaskedPAN.definition: Masked PAN to be printed on payment receipts or displayed to the cardholder. Masked digits may be absent or replaced by another character as '*'.

IssuerBIN.name: Issuer BIN
IssuerBIN.definition: Bank identifier number of the issuer for routing purpose.

CardCountryCode.name: Card Country Code
CardCountryCode.definition: Country code assigned to the card by the card issuer.

CardCurrencyCode.name: Card Currency Code
CardCurrencyCode.definition: Currency code of the card issuer (ISO 4217 numeric code).

CardProductProfile.name: Card Product Profile
CardProductProfile.definition: Defines a category of cards related to the acceptance processing rules defined by the acquirer.

InternationalCard.name: International Card
InternationalCard.definition: True if the card may be used abroad.

AllowedProduct.name: Allowed Product
AllowedProduct.definition: Product that can be purchased with the card.

ServiceOption.name: Service Option
ServiceOption.definition: Options to the service provided by the card.
